gui.vtm.title: Vampire Sheet
gui.vtm.mortal: You are mortal. The Blood has not claimed you.
message.vtm.no_blood: There is nothing to drink here.
message.vtm.stain: Your Beast stirs. You feel a stain on your soul.
commands.vtm.info: %s: %s, clan %s, generation %s, blood potency %s, blood %s, humanity %s, stains %s, xp %s
clan.vtm.banu_haqim.desc: Assamite judges and assassins who weigh the sins of the Kindred.
clan.vtm.banu_haqim.bane: Blood thirst: you frenzy from hunger sooner (at hunger 4), and tasting another vampire's vitae throws you into frenzy.
clan.vtm.brujah.desc: Passionate rebels and idealists, quick to fight for a cause.
clan.vtm.brujah.bane: Violent temper: when a fight takes you below 40% health, the Beast takes over in frenzy.
clan.vtm.gangrel.desc: Wanderers and survivors who feel the Beast closest to the surface.
clan.vtm.gangrel.bane: Bestial features: every frenzy leaves a lasting animal trait (up to 5) that makes villagers distrust you. Quell the Beast sheds one.
clan.vtm.hecata.desc: Keepers of death, bound in a family of necromancers.
clan.vtm.hecata.bane: Painful kiss: your bite is brutal and hurts far more than other vampires' bites.
clan.vtm.lasombra.desc: Dark aristocrats who command shadow and ambition alike.
clan.vtm.lasombra.bane: Distorted image: something is wrong with how you look, and villagers keep a measure of distrust towards you.
clan.vtm.malkavian.desc: Seers whose madness is a window onto hidden truths.
clan.vtm.malkavian.bane: Fractured perspective: every so often your mind slips. You hear things that aren't there and feel dizzy.
clan.vtm.ministry.desc: Serpent-priests who sell temptation and freedom.
clan.vtm.ministry.bane: Aversion to light: sunlight burns you twice as hard.
clan.vtm.nosferatu.desc: Horrors in the dark who hold the Camarilla's deepest secrets.
clan.vtm.nosferatu.bane: Repulsive: your hideous visage makes villagers deeply distrust you.
clan.vtm.ravnos.desc: Nomadic illusionists who live by their wits and their road.
clan.vtm.ravnos.bane: Doomed: stay near one place for 30 minutes and your blood sours: it drains away, and you grow dizzy.
clan.vtm.salubri.desc: Healers hunted for their third eye and their gift of mercy.
clan.vtm.salubri.bane: Hunted: biting costs you. The third eye weeps and you take damage each time you feed.
clan.vtm.toreador.desc: Artists and aesthetes who chase beauty and the perfect moment.
clan.vtm.toreador.bane: Aesthetic fixation: in lightless underground places your hands slow and your focus dulls.
clan.vtm.tremere.desc: Warlock-scholars who forged their blood into a weapon.
clan.vtm.tremere.bane: Stunted blood: only three quarters of the blood you drink takes hold.
clan.vtm.tzimisce.desc: Fiends of the old world who sculpt flesh and own their domain.
clan.vtm.tzimisce.bane: Grounded: stray more than 512 blocks from your haven (your bed or spawn point), or into another realm, and you weaken and bleed.
clan.vtm.ventrue.desc: Born leaders of Kindred society, rulers of the powerful.
clan.vtm.ventrue.bane: Rarefied tastes: you can feed only on humans. Animal blood sickens you, unless the Beast is in control.
clan.vtm.caitiff.desc: Clanless Kindred with no sire to teach them, outcasts everywhere.
clan.vtm.caitiff.bane: Clanless: every discipline is learned at the out-of-clan price.
clan.vtm.thin_blood.desc: Children of the thinning blood, barely vampires at all.
clan.vtm.thin_blood.bane: Thin: sunlight scorches you only half as hard, but your gifts are limited to Thin-Blood Alchemy.
power.vtm.sense_the_beast.desc: Reveals every living creature within 24 blocks for a few seconds.
power.vtm.feral_whispers.desc: Tames wild wolves, cats and other tameable animals within 10 blocks.
power.vtm.quell_the_beast.desc: Cleanses harmful effects, ends a frenzy without a lapse, lifts one stain and sheds one bestial feature.
power.vtm.summon_pack.desc: Calls three tame wolves to fight for you for a minute.
power.vtm.drawing_out_the_beast.desc: Hostile creatures nearby are gripped by primal fear: they weaken, slow and stop hunting you.
power.vtm.sense_the_unseen.desc: Strips invisibility from everything within 32 blocks and makes it glow.
power.vtm.premonition.desc: Foresight shields you with absorption hearts and good luck.
power.vtm.scry_the_soul.desc: Look into a creature or player to read their health, nature and clan.
power.vtm.share_the_senses.desc: See through the eyes of the creature you are looking at, for 20 seconds. Your body stands helpless meanwhile. Use again to return; being hurt breaks the link.
power.vtm.blood_bolt.desc: Hurls a bolt of corrosive vitae at the creature you are looking at.
power.vtm.extinguish_vitae.desc: Boils the blood of a target; the undead and vampires take double damage.
power.vtm.blood_of_potency.desc: Temporarily deepens your blood: Strength II and Resistance for a minute.
power.vtm.scorpions_touch.desc: Your touch spoils a victim's blood: Wither and Weakness.
power.vtm.theft_of_vitae.desc: Rip blood from a target at range and drink it. Drains vampires of their vitae.
power.vtm.cats_grace.desc: Passive: +5% movement speed per Celerity dot.
power.vtm.rapid_reflexes.desc: Haste II and Jump Boost for 30 seconds.
power.vtm.blink.desc: Vanish and reappear up to 10 blocks ahead.
power.vtm.traversal.desc: Speed IV, Jump Boost III and slow falling for 10 seconds.
power.vtm.cloud_memory.desc: A creature forgets you and will not hunt you for 20 seconds.
power.vtm.compel.desc: Command a creature to stand still and ignore you.
power.vtm.mesmerize.desc: Turn a creature against the nearest other mob.
power.vtm.mass_compel.desc: Every creature within 10 blocks is stilled and loses interest in you.
power.vtm.absolute_command.desc: Villagers give you the best prices; other creatures are calmed for a minute and empowered.
power.vtm.resilience.desc: Passive: armor, toughness and knockback resistance per Fortitude dot.
power.vtm.defy_bane.desc: Fire resistance for 90 seconds; sunlight cannot burn you.
power.vtm.fortify_the_inner_facade.desc: Six absorption hearts and Resistance II.
power.vtm.unseen_passage.desc: Invisibility for 45 seconds; anything hunting you loses the trail.
power.vtm.ghost_walk.desc: Creatures cannot target you for 30 seconds, and you move faster.
power.vtm.mask_of_a_thousand_faces.desc: Invisible and unnoticed by all creatures for a minute.
power.vtm.vanish.desc: Unseen and untargetable for two minutes, with a burst of speed.
power.vtm.oblivions_sight.desc: Night vision, and the undead and vampires within 32 blocks glow.
power.vtm.shadow_cast.desc: Smothers nearby creatures in darkness: blinded, slowed and distracted.
power.vtm.arms_of_the_abyss.desc: Shadowy limbs drag everything within 10 blocks toward you.
power.vtm.withering.desc: Rots a target with Wither II.
power.vtm.necrotic_plague.desc: A wave of decay: everything within 6 blocks withers, weakens and slows.
power.vtm.lethal_body.desc: Passive: more melee damage and knockback per Potence dot.
power.vtm.soaring_leap.desc: Leap far in the direction you are facing and land softly.
power.vtm.brutal_strike.desc: A crushing blow to everything in front of you.
power.vtm.earthshock.desc: Slam the ground: everything within 7 blocks is hurt, thrown and slowed.
power.vtm.awe.desc: Mortals adore you: Hero of the Village for three minutes.
power.vtm.daunt.desc: Nearby creatures are cowed: weakened, slowed and unwilling to attack.
power.vtm.entrancement.desc: Animals within 12 blocks fall under your spell: tamed, or driven into a loving mood.
power.vtm.dread_gaze.desc: Your stare cripples a target: weakness, slowness and blindness.
power.vtm.majesty.desc: An unbearable presence: Resistance III and every creature nearby stands down.
power.vtm.weight_of_the_feather.desc: Slow falling and Jump Boost II for a minute.
power.vtm.feral_weapons.desc: Claws and fangs: Strength and Haste II for 45 seconds.
power.vtm.earth_meld.desc: Sink into the earth: nearly invulnerable, regenerating and unseen, but unable to move for 10 seconds.
power.vtm.shapechange.desc: Become a wolf: small, fast and agile. Use again to change back. Holding a form slowly costs blood.
power.vtm.far_reach.desc: Telekinetically pull every dropped item within 12 blocks to you.
power.vtm.catalyze.desc: An alchemical stimulant: Haste III and Strength for 40 seconds.
power.vtm.wake_with_evenings_fire.desc: Fire resistance for 90 seconds, letting you walk in daylight.
power.vtm.prismatic.desc: All the alchemy at once: Resistance II, Speed II and Strength II for 20 seconds.
gui.vtm.no_powers: Learn a discipline to unlock its powers.
message.vtm.power_locked: You have not mastered that power.
message.vtm.power_fizzled: The power fizzles: no valid target.
message.vtm.no_power_selected: No power selected. Cycle with Z / X.
power.vtm.bat_form.desc: Become a bat: tiny, and able to fly. Use again to change back. Holding a form slowly costs blood.
power.vtm.mist_form.desc: Dissolve into drifting mist: invisible, flying and untouched by almost everything, but unable to act. Fire still burns you.
message.vtm.frenzied: You are in a frenzy and cannot use your powers.
message.vtm.bane_prey: The blood is vile to you. Your kind cannot stomach it.
message.vtm.bestial_feature: The frenzy leaves its mark: you gain a bestial feature.
message.vtm.doomed: The road calls. You have lingered too long.
message.vtm.ungrounded: You are far from your haven; the soil's pull fades.
message.vtm.form_lost: You have no blood left to hold your shape.
dialogue.vtm.roll.messy: Messy critical: it works, but the Beast shows
message.vtm.refuses.busy: %s is busy talking to someone else.
dialogue.vtm.opt.rumors: Ask what has been happening around here.
dialogue.vtm.opt.charm: Ask, gently, for a taste of their blood.
dialogue.vtm.locked.fed: They have already given what they will.
dialogue.vtm.opt.compel: Hold their gaze and compel them to offer a wrist.
dialogue.vtm.locked.dominate: Requires Dominate, and a willing wrist.
dialogue.vtm.civilian.greet.familiar: You again, %2$s. I seem to see you everywhere lately.
dialogue.vtm.civilian.greet.night: Awfully late to be out, friend. Can I help you? I'm %1$s.
dialogue.vtm.civilian.greet.day: Oh, hello. Can I help you? I'm %1$s.
dialogue.vtm.civilian.smalltalk: Oh, you know. Work, rent, the neighbours. Nothing a stranger would care about. But thanks for asking. Nobody asks.
dialogue.vtm.civilian.rumors.night: Don't tell anyone I said so, but I keep my curtains shut after sundown. Something is off in this district.
dialogue.vtm.civilian.rumors.day: People have been going missing after dark. The police say they're runaways. Nobody believes them.
dialogue.vtm.civilian.give: %1$s hesitates, then rolls back a sleeve with a nervous laugh. "Just... don't make it weird." You drink gently, and they will remember it as a strange dream.
dialogue.vtm.civilian.refuse: "My what?" %1$s backs away, laughing too loudly. "I'm, uh... I think I should go."
dialogue.vtm.civilian.compelled: %1$s's eyes go glassy. They offer a wrist without a word. When you release them, they blink, confused, and drift away.
dialogue.vtm.civilian.slip: %1$s flinches as if from a draught. "Why did you look at me like that?" Something about you has put them on edge.
dialogue.vtm.civilian_wary.greet.threat: S-stay back! I... I saw what you did.
dialogue.vtm.civilian_wary.greet: You make me nervous. Please, just keep your distance.
dialogue.vtm.civilian_wary.apologised: %1$s watches you for a long moment. "I suppose people do things they regret." They don't relax, but they don't run either.
dialogue.vtm.civilian_wary.reassured: Your voice is steady. Slowly, %1$s's shoulders drop. "Okay. Okay. I won't tell anyone."
dialogue.vtm.civilian_wary.spooked: That only makes it worse. %1$s edges toward the nearest door.
dialogue.vtm.opt.friend_blood: Ask if they would spare a little blood.
dialogue.vtm.opt.strange: Ask if they have noticed anything strange.
dialogue.vtm.civilian_friendly.greet: %2$s! Good to see you. You're always welcome here.
dialogue.vtm.civilian_friendly.how: Better for the company. It's a lonely city if you let it be.
dialogue.vtm.civilian_friendly.give: "Of course. Anything for a friend." %1$s offers an arm and looks away. It is easy, and strange how little it costs them.
dialogue.vtm.civilian_friendly.strange: Since you ask: there's a tall figure in a long coat who only comes out after dark. Walks like he owns the street. I'd stay clear, if I were you.
dialogue.vtm.vampire_mortal.greet: A mortal, out at this hour. Walk away. I will not tell you twice.
dialogue.vtm.opt.mortal_know: Tell them you know what they are.
dialogue.vtm.vampire_mortal.deflect: "Nobody you need to know." %1$s's gaze lingers on your throat a moment too long.
dialogue.vtm.vampire_mortal.warned: "Careful." The word is quiet and very cold. "Some secrets have a price. Leave. Now."
dialogue.vtm.opt.ask_city: Ask what is happening in the city.
dialogue.vtm.locked.introduce: They will not share secrets with a stranger. Introduce yourself first.
dialogue.vtm.locked.rapport: They do not trust you enough yet.
dialogue.vtm.vampire_camarilla.greet.fam: Kindred %2$s. The Prince's eyes are everywhere, and you appear to be in them. Good.
dialogue.vtm.vampire_camarilla.greet: Well met, %2$s. I am %1$s, of Clan %3$s. I trust you keep the Masquerade.
dialogue.vtm.vampire_camarilla.intro: "A pleasure. Your reputation is, as yet, a blank page. See that it remains a clean one." %1$s inclines their head: a courtesy, and a measurement.
dialogue.vtm.vampire_camarilla.sect: "The Camarilla keeps us hidden, and so keeps us alive. Six Traditions, one Prince to a city, and a Masquerade no Kindred may break. Society, %2$s. That is what survives."
dialogue.vtm.vampire_camarilla.rumor: "The Prince is displeased with the Anarchs in the east. Kindred have been seen feeding where mortals might watch. I would not want to be the one blamed."
dialogue.vtm.vampire_camarilla.teach: "You show promise. Come, a few words from one who has kept the Masquerade longer than you have been dead." The lesson is brief, and it sticks.
dialogue.vtm.vampire_anarch.greet.famili: Ha, %2$s! Back again. Pull up some floor.
dialogue.vtm.vampire_anarch.greet: Hey. %1$s. %3$s, if you care for labels. You're not with the Camarilla? Good.
dialogue.vtm.vampire_anarch.intro: "Nice to meet you, %2$s. Out here a name and a bit of nerve is all you need." %1$s grins, all teeth.
dialogue.vtm.vampire_anarch.sect: "The Anarchs answer to nobody. No Prince, no elders sitting on a throne of other people's blood. Barons keep the peace; the rest of us keep each other alive."
dialogue.vtm.vampire_anarch.rumor: "Word is the Camarilla's cleaners are sniffing round the old warehouses. Keep your head down and your blood fresh."
dialogue.vtm.vampire_anarch.teach: "No courts, no ranks, but I've learned a thing or two the hard way. Here, let me show you before someone less friendly does."
dialogue.vtm.vampire_sabbat.greet.famili: %2$s. You are persistent. The pack has noticed.
dialogue.vtm.vampire_sabbat.greet: I am %1$s of the %3$s. You stand before the Sword of Caine, %2$s. Choose your words with care.
dialogue.vtm.vampire_sabbat.intro: "You have a name. Names are cheap. Show the Sabbat what you are and I will remember it." %1$s's smile never reaches their eyes.
dialogue.vtm.vampire_sabbat.sect: "We do not hide from what we are. The Camarilla are cattle who pretend not to be wolves. The Sabbat embrace the Beast, and each other."
dialogue.vtm.vampire_sabbat.rumor: "There is a Camarilla coterie in the old quarter, fat on stolen peace. When the pack is ready, they will learn what hunger means."
dialogue.vtm.vampire_sabbat.teach: "The pack teaches or the pack buries. I will teach you, once. Do not waste it."
dialogue.vtm.vampire_independent.greet.f: You have found me again. I wonder what you want.
dialogue.vtm.vampire_independent.greet: %1$s, of %3$s. I answer to no court. State your business, %2$s.
dialogue.vtm.vampire_independent.intro: "I do not often make introductions. But you are polite, %2$s, and that is rarer than blood."
dialogue.vtm.vampire_independent.sect: "Some of us belong to neither court nor crusade. We keep our own counsel, our own domain, our own memories. It is a lonely sort of freedom."
dialogue.vtm.vampire_independent.rumor: "The courts squabble, the pack hunts, and none of them look up. Something older stirs below the city. I have said too much already."
dialogue.vtm.vampire_independent.teach: "Old blood teaches in odd ways. Sit. Listen. Remember."
dialogue.vtm.vampire_other.greet.familia: You have found me again. I wonder what you want.
dialogue.vtm.vampire_other.greet: %1$s, of %3$s. I answer to no court. State your business, %2$s.
dialogue.vtm.vampire_other.intro: "I do not often make introductions. But you are polite, %2$s, and that is rarer than blood."
dialogue.vtm.vampire_other.sect: "Some of us belong to neither court nor crusade. We keep our own counsel, our own domain, our own memories. It is a lonely sort of freedom."
dialogue.vtm.vampire_other.rumor: "The courts squabble, the pack hunts, and none of them look up. Something older stirs below the city. I have said too much already."
dialogue.vtm.vampire_other.teach: "Old blood teaches in odd ways. Sit. Listen. Remember."
dialogue.vtm.renounce.confirm: "Think carefully. Leaving carries a price, and they will remember it."
dialogue.vtm.renounce.done: "Then you are nothing to us." %1$s turns away.
dialogue.vtm.opt.join: Ask to be accepted into the %4$s.
dialogue.vtm.opt.serve: Offer your services to the sect.
dialogue.vtm.opt.promote: Ask to be advanced within the sect.
dialogue.vtm.locked.promote: You have not earned the standing for it yet.
dialogue.vtm.vampire_camarilla.joined: "Then you are Camarilla. Keep the Traditions, and the Prince will keep you." %1$s makes it formal with a nod.
dialogue.vtm.vampire_camarilla.served: "Your service is noted. The Prince values those who are useful, and quiet."
dialogue.vtm.vampire_camarilla.promoted: "You have earned it. Do not make me regret vouching for you." %1$s's seal is cool against your palm.
dialogue.vtm.vampire_camarilla.greet.mem: Kindred %2$s, of our own Camarilla. What do you need?
dialogue.vtm.vampire_anarch.joined: "Welcome to the movement, %2$s. No papers, no oaths. Just don't sell us out."
dialogue.vtm.vampire_anarch.served: "Cheers. Word gets around about who actually helps."
dialogue.vtm.vampire_anarch.promoted: "Look at you, moving up. Don't let it go to your head, we hate that." %1$s claps your shoulder.
dialogue.vtm.vampire_anarch.greet.member: %2$s! One of ours. What's the word?
dialogue.vtm.vampire_sabbat.joined: "Then take the vaulderie, packmate." %1$s offers the cup. "Drink, and you are of us."
dialogue.vtm.vampire_sabbat.served: "The pack remembers who bleeds for it."
dialogue.vtm.vampire_sabbat.promoted: "The pack sees your worth. Rise." %1$s's grip is iron on your wrist.
dialogue.vtm.vampire_sabbat.greet.member: Packmate %2$s. The Sword of Caine watches. Speak.
gui.vtm.sect.none: You have sworn fealty to no sect.
gui.vtm.sect.none_hint: Earn the trust of a sect's vampires in conversation, then ask to be accepted.
gui.vtm.sect.top: You have reached the highest rank.
message.vtm.sect.promoted: You are raised to the rank of %s.
dialogue.vtm.opt.n_bind: Offer your blood, and bind them to you.
dialogue.vtm.opt.n_humiliate: Break their pride, and let them crawl away.
dialogue.vtm.nemesis_yield.hub: "Enough." %1$s lowers their head, blood on their lips. "You have beaten me, %2$s. Decide."
dialogue.vtm.nemesis_yield.refused: %1$s spits blood at your feet. "I will never kneel to you."
dialogue.vtm.nemesis_yield.bound: %1$s drinks. Something behind their eyes bends, and settles. "Master," they say, and it is not mockery.
dialogue.vtm.opt.b_tithe: Share a little of your blood with them.
dialogue.vtm.opt.b_listen: Ask what they have heard in the night.
dialogue.vtm.nemesis_bound.tithed: %1$s takes the offered blood with something like reverence.
dialogue.vtm.nemesis_bound.listened: "Whispers, mostly. Let me tell you what I could learn."
dialogue.vtm.nemesis_bound.release: "If you wish it." %1$s's voice is flat. "Though I will not pretend I never served you."
dialogue.vtm.opt.r_kin: Ask about their kin and their rivals.
dialogue.vtm.locked.respect: They do not respect you enough to say.
dialogue.vtm.nemesis_respected.greet.spa: %2$s. You spared me once, and I have not forgotten what that cost you to give.
dialogue.vtm.nemesis_respected.greet.bea: %2$s. You are the one who beat me. I find I do not mind talking to you.
dialogue.vtm.nemesis_respected.greet: %2$s. I have heard your name said in the right rooms.
dialogue.vtm.nemesis_respected.kin: "Family and enemies are the same thing, in the end. Listen, then."
dialogue.vtm.nemesis_respected.court: "You ask boldly. Very well: here is how my court is really made."
trait.vtm.iron_will.desc: Hard to move and harder to wound: extra armour, and immune to being knocked back.
trait.vtm.bloodthirsty.desc: Heals itself with every wound it deals.
trait.vtm.swift.desc: Moves far faster than its kind.
trait.vtm.brute.desc: Hits much harder, but is slower on its feet.
trait.vtm.deflector.desc: Arrows and thrown weapons barely scratch it.
trait.vtm.undying.desc: Survives one more defeat than its station should allow.
trait.vtm.fire_hardened.desc: Shrugs off flames and bears the sun with ease.
trait.vtm.commander.desc: Never comes alone: brings a larger retinue.
trait.vtm.sun_scarred.desc: Burns twice as quickly in sunlight.
trait.vtm.flammable.desc: Fire does nearly twice the damage.
trait.vtm.brittle.desc: Arrows and thrown weapons hurt it badly.
trait.vtm.glass_jaw.desc: Has far less health than it should.
trait.vtm.coward.desc: Flees when badly hurt rather than fight to the end.
trait.vtm.hunger_bound.desc: Fights poorly when it is hungry.
trait.vtm.vengeful.desc: Nurses a grudge twice as hard, and never lets one fade.
trait.vtm.patient.desc: Stalks its enemies thoroughly, and strikes when it is ready.
trait.vtm.proud.desc: Will never yield, and never forgives being humiliated.
trait.vtm.reckless.desc: Hits harder, but leaves itself open.
trait.vtm.grateful.desc: Remembers mercy, and is far easier to win over.
chronicle.vtm.adapted: %1$s has learned from their defeats, and is harder to hurt.
chronicle.vtm.spared_away: %1$s was left alive, and slipped away.
chronicle.vtm.leader_destroyed_by: %1$s, who led their court, was destroyed by %2$s.
chronicle.vtm.leader_destroyed: %1$s, who led their court, has been destroyed.
chronicle.vtm.bound_lost: %1$s, once bound to a master, is no more.
chronicle.vtm.seat_abandoned: %1$s has abandoned their seat in the court.
chronicle.vtm.awoke: %1$s has awoken from torpor, stronger than before.
chronicle.vtm.promoted: %1$s has been raised in the court.
chronicle.vtm.hunt_failed: %1$s, sent by %3$s, failed to bring down %2$s.
message.vtm.nemesis.met: You have taken the measure of %s.
message.vtm.nemesis.learned_kin: You learn who %s keeps close, and who they fear.
message.vtm.nemesis.nothing_new: There is nothing new to learn.
message.vtm.nemesis.ambush: You are being hunted. Something has come for you in the dark.
message.vtm.nemesis.tithed: %s is bound to you a little more tightly.
message.vtm.nemesis.bound: %s kneels to you, bound by your blood.
message.vtm.nemesis.cannot_bind: You cannot bind them: you need blood to give and a free place at your side.
message.vtm.nemesis.spy_caught: %s was caught spying, and has not returned.
message.vtm.nemesis.spy_report: %s returns from the shadows with word.
message.vtm.nemesis.spy_nothing: %s returns, with nothing you did not already know.
message.vtm.nemesis.hunt_nothing: %s found no one to hunt, and returns empty-handed.
message.vtm.nemesis.hunt_won: %s returns from the hunt: %s is down.
message.vtm.nemesis.betrayed: %s no longer feels the pull of your blood, and has turned on you.
nemesis.vtm.taunt.encounter.0: So you are the one they speak of, %1$s. Let us see what you are.
nemesis.vtm.taunt.encounter.1: You walk in my night, %1$s. That was a mistake.
nemesis.vtm.taunt.rematch.0: You again, %1$s. I have not forgotten how you beat me.
nemesis.vtm.taunt.rematch.1: Back for a second try, %1$s? I am not what I was.
nemesis.vtm.taunt.scarred.0: See these marks, %1$s? You gave me those. I mean to return them.
nemesis.vtm.taunt.scarred.1: Every scar you gave me has taught me something, %1$s. Class begins.
nemesis.vtm.taunt.mercy.0: You spared me, %1$s. I have not decided whether that was kindness or insult.
nemesis.vtm.taunt.mercy.1: Mercy is a strange thing to be owed, %1$s.
nemesis.vtm.taunt.victor.0: I killed you once, %1$s. It will be easier the second time.
nemesis.vtm.taunt.victor.1: I remember your last breath, %1$s. I would like to hear it again.
nemesis.vtm.taunt.self_low.1: You will pay in blood for this, %1$s!
nemesis.vtm.taunt.yield.1: I... I yield, %1$s. Do what you will.
nemesis.vtm.taunt.flee.0: This is not the end, %1$s. I will return.
nemesis.vtm.taunt.ambush.0: I have waited long for this, %1$s.
nemesis.vtm.taunt.ambush.1: Did you think I would forget you, %1$s?
gui.vtm.nemesis.title: Nemeses
gui.vtm.nemesis.empty: You know of no named vampires yet. Meet them, watch them fight, or ask around: someone always knows a name.
gui.vtm.nemesis.only_heard: You have only heard the name.
gui.vtm.nemesis.blood_hunt: The sect has declared a blood hunt on you
gui.vtm.nemesis.mark.tip: Bound vampires can be sent to hunt the marked target (Coterie tab).
gui.vtm.nemesis.no_courts: No court has been seen yet.
gui.vtm.nemesis.no_news: Nothing has happened that you have heard of.
gui.vtm.nemesis.no_coterie: No one is bound to you. Beat a named vampire, and offer them your blood.
gui.vtm.nemesis.hunt.none: Mark a target in the Dossiers tab first.
message.vtm.coffin.mortal: You would rather not lie down in a coffin.
message.vtm.coffin.night: The night is young. Your haven is set here.
message.vtm.coffin.unsafe: You cannot rest with enemies so close.
message.vtm.coffin.slept: You sleep through the day, and wake at dusk.
dialogue.vtm.watchman.suspicious: I know your face from the reports, %2$s. Keep your hands where I can see them.
dialogue.vtm.watchman.greet: Evening, citizen. The watch keeps the peace in %6$s. Anything to report?
dialogue.vtm.opt.w_trouble: Ask about the trouble in the city.
dialogue.vtm.opt.w_calm: Convince them you are no trouble.
dialogue.vtm.watchman.trouble: "People go missing after dark. We find the clothes, never the people. The watch is told not to ask who is responsible."
dialogue.vtm.watchman.rulers: "Officially the council. In truth the %7$s hold %6$s, and they hold it tightly. The watch answers to them whether it likes to or not."
dialogue.vtm.watchman.calmed: %1$s studies you, then nods slowly. "All right. I will remember you were reasonable."
dialogue.vtm.watchman.unconvinced: "That is exactly what a guilty person says." %1$s's hand rests on their sword.
dialogue.vtm.opt.s_browse: Look at what is for sale.
dialogue.vtm.shopkeeper.greet: Welcome, %2$s. Have a look around. Nothing here that bites.
dialogue.vtm.shopkeeper.browse: Candles, rope, garlic that nobody buys any more, and a great deal of salt. Business has been strange lately.
dialogue.vtm.shopkeeper.gossip: "You did not hear this from me." %1$s leans over the counter, and lowers their voice.
dialogue.vtm.shopkeeper.rulers: "The %7$s. Nobody says it, everybody knows it. Pay on time, keep your windows shuttered at night, and %6$s is a lovely place to live."
dialogue.vtm.bartender.greet: What'll it be, %2$s? The night is young, and so, apparently, are most of my customers.
dialogue.vtm.bartender.order: %1$s slides a glass across the bar without being asked twice. "First one is always on the house."
dialogue.vtm.bartender.regulars: "The pale ones come in after midnight and never drink anything. Pay in old coins. Tip well. I stopped asking."
dialogue.vtm.bartender.rulers: "The %7$s keep the peace in %6$s. In return, the %7$s drink here free. I would rather not think about what they drink."
message.vtm.city.stone: %1$s, a city of the %2$s. Their hold on it: %3$s%%.
message.vtm.city.watched: The watch of %1$s has noticed you.
message.vtm.city.wanted: The watch of %1$s is after you!
message.vtm.city.reinforcements: The watch of %1$s sends more guards!
dialogue.vtm.opt.roads: Ask about the road, and what lies at the end of it.
dialogue.vtm.shopkeeper.roads: "Travellers talk. Let me think what I have heard about the towns round here."
dialogue.vtm.bartender.roads: "Everyone who drinks here has come from somewhere. Let me think who said what."
chronicle.vtm.city_taken: %1$s led the %3$s in taking %2$s from the %4$s.
chronicle.vtm.city_held: %1$s's assault on %2$s was beaten back by the %3$s.
chronicle.vtm.city_weakened: %1$s no longer holds %2$s, and its rulers' grip on the city weakens.
commands.vtm.city.none_here: You are not in a city
gui.vtm.nemesis.no_domains: You know of no cities yet. Visit one, or ask the people who live in them.
message.vtm.city.learned: You learn of %1$s, a city of the %2$s.
dialogue.vtm.opt.c_city: Ask what they have heard of the cities.
dialogue.vtm.court_subject.greet: "My liege." %1$s bows low. "The court is yours to command."
dialogue.vtm.court_subject.report: "As you wish. Here is what I have gathered, and what I have not been able to put in writing."
dialogue.vtm.court_subject.cities: "Travellers speak of towns, and I listen. Let me tell you of one."
dialogue.vtm.court_subject.oath: %1$s straightens. "I have not forgotten what I swore to you, my liege. You will not need to remind me again."
chronicle.vtm.abdicated: %1$s gave up the throne of the %2$s.
chronicle.vtm.appointed: %1$s was given a seat in the court by %2$s.
chronicle.vtm.dismissed: %1$s lost their seat in the court.
chronicle.vtm.truce: %1$s's court agreed a truce with the %2$s.
gui.vtm.court.intro: A sect member of rank and standing may take a throne that stands empty: when its ruler has been destroyed, bound or deposed and no one has taken their place yet. The simulation will fill the seat within two nights unless you do.
gui.vtm.court.can_claim: The throne is yours for the taking.
gui.vtm.court.block.low_rank: You need at least the second rank of your sect.
gui.vtm.court.block.low_standing: You need standing of at least 40 with your sect.
gui.vtm.court.block.throne_held: Someone sits on the throne. Remove them: destroy, bind or topple them.
decree.vtm.strict_masquerade.desc: Your cities enforce the Masquerade and cool faster; breaches cost standing with you.
decree.vtm.open_hunting.desc: Your cities stop policing feeding and bring in more, but slowly lose their hold.
decree.vtm.tithes.desc: Tribute is half as large again; the court resents it.
decree.vtm.war_footing.desc: Your faction raids and attacks cities far more often; enforcers like it.
decree.vtm.peace.desc: Your faction does not attack. The ambitious grow restless.
decree.vtm.patronage.desc: Spends 1 influence a minute to keep the court loyal.
petition.vtm.quarrel: %1$s and %2$s are at each other's throats, and want you to take a side.
petition.vtm.envoy: An envoy of the %1$s asks for a truce.
petition.vtm.sanctuary: %3$s, a vampire of the %1$s, begs sanctuary in your court.
petition.vtm.fortify: %1$s is under pressure and asks for help.
petition.vtm.tribunal: %1$s stands accused of corruption in your name.
message.vtm.court.claimed: You take the throne of the %s.
message.vtm.court.abdicated: You have given up the throne.
message.vtm.court.patronage_lapsed: You can no longer afford to patronise the court.
gui.vtm.hint.default: Q / E pages   Tab focus   Enter select
gui.vtm.hint.disciplines: Hover a row for what it unlocks.
gui.vtm.hint.powers: Arm a power, then use it in the world.
gui.vtm.hint.dossiers: Up / Down browse. Mark a hunt target.
gui.vtm.hint.domains: Click a city on the map.
gui.vtm.soul.note: Humanity falls with every cruelty, and the Beast grows to fill the gap.
gui.vtm.mortal.hint: Only the Embraced have a codex of their own. The pages under THE NIGHT show what you have learned of the vampires around you.
gui.vtm.learn.tip: Spend %s experience to raise this discipline.
gui.vtm.clan_only.tip: Outside your clan's blood. Only a clan discipline can be learned this way.
gui.vtm.court.collect.tip: Gather the tribute your cities have paid.
gui.vtm.nemesis.spy_target.tip: Choose which court a spy is sent to.
dialogue.vtm.civilian.greet.cheerful: Oh, it's you again, %2$s! Good to see a friendly face. I'm %1$s, in case I never said.
dialogue.vtm.civilian.smalltalk.cheerful: Rent's high and the bread's stale but the sun was out today, and that counts. How are you?
dialogue.vtm.civilian.greet.nervous: Oh! You startled me. Sorry. I'm a bit jumpy lately, %2$s. What do you need?
dialogue.vtm.civilian.smalltalk.nervous: Have you noticed how many people have gone quiet lately? No? ...Forget I said anything. Please.
dialogue.vtm.civilian.greet.brave: Evening, %2$s. Don't mind me standing my ground; I don't scare easy. What's on your mind?
dialogue.vtm.civilian.smalltalk.brave: I've walked these streets all my life. Whatever is out there after dark, I'll meet it standing.
dialogue.vtm.civilian.greet.suspicious: %2$s. Right. What do you want? And why do you keep turning up?
dialogue.vtm.civilian.smalltalk.suspicio: Why do you want to know? ...Work and home, that's all there is to say.
dialogue.vtm.civilian.greet.lonely: %2$s! Come, talk to me a while. I don't get many people to talk to.
dialogue.vtm.civilian.smalltalk.lonely: My days are long. Quiet. I talk to the pigeons. They don't answer. You do. Thank you.
dialogue.vtm.civilian.greet.devout: Peace be with you, %2$s. It is a hard world for a soul to cross alone.
dialogue.vtm.civilian.smalltalk.devout: I pray for the lost ones, you know. All of them. Even the ones who have forgotten how to be found.
dialogue.vtm.civilian.greet.curious: %2$s! I was just wondering where you came from. Tell me everything. Or anything.
dialogue.vtm.civilian.smalltalk.curious: I read everything I can about this city. The old houses. The older families. Some very odd stories.
dialogue.vtm.civilian.family: I live with my %9$s, %8$s. We look after each other. Mostly %8$s looks after me.
dialogue.vtm.grieving.hub: You. I know what you did, %2$s. One of mine is gone, and you did it. Get away from me before I scream.
dialogue.vtm.grieving.opt.forgive: Say how sorry you are, and mean it.
dialogue.vtm.grieving.forgiven: ...I can't forgive you. But I won't tell anyone. Go.
dialogue.vtm.priest.greet: Welcome. The doors are open to anyone, at any hour. I am %1$s. How may I help you, %2$s?
dialogue.vtm.priest.greet.wary: I feel a chill about you, %2$s. I will speak with you, but do not come closer.
dialogue.vtm.priest.confessed: You do not say everything, I think. But what you do say is heavy, and it lightens in the telling. Go in peace; try to do better.
dialogue.vtm.priest.faith: It is simple, and hard: that no one is beyond mercy, and that none of us are owed it. The doors stay open for that reason.
dialogue.vtm.priest.opt.sleepers: Ask about those who are never seen by day.
dialogue.vtm.priest.sleepers: People come to me at night and confess things they never saw clearly. Names, mostly. I do not repeat them. But I listen, and so I know a little.
dialogue.vtm.priest.opt.reveal: Tell the priest what you are.
dialogue.vtm.priest.revealed: ...Dear God. Do not come near me. Leave this place.
dialogue.vtm.clerk.greet: Good day. Front desk, %1$s speaking. Deliveries, complaints, directions, anything.
dialogue.vtm.clerk.opt.ledger: Ask to see the visitors' ledger.
dialogue.vtm.clerk.locked: The ledger has been put away for today.
dialogue.vtm.clerk.ledger: Strictly speaking, I shouldn't. But here: people sign in from all over. Look, this one came from out of town.
dialogue.vtm.clerk.tenants: Quiet lot, mostly. The upper floors keep odd hours and pay on time, so I don't ask.
dialogue.vtm.detective.greet: Detective %1$s. Nothing's wrong, as far as I know. Do you need something, %2$s?
dialogue.vtm.detective.greet.hot: %2$s. Sit. We've had a run of incidents, and your name keeps coming up. I'd like to hear it from you.
dialogue.vtm.detective.opt.lie: Lie smoothly. It was nothing to do with you.
dialogue.vtm.detective.lie_ok: ...Hm. That fits. It will have to do. Stay out of trouble.
dialogue.vtm.detective.lie_bad: That doesn't add up, and you know it. I'm writing this down. Don't leave town.
dialogue.vtm.detective.opt.cooperate: Cooperate, and tell the part of the truth that is safe.
dialogue.vtm.detective.cooperate: Thank you. That is more than most would say. I'll make a note that you helped.
dialogue.vtm.detective.opt.intimidate: Hold their eye, and make them forget the question.
dialogue.vtm.detective.intimidated: ...I... what was I asking? It's nothing. It's nothing. Forget I said anything.
dialogue.vtm.detective.intimidate_bad: What are you doing? Your eyes... Stay away from me! Officers!
dialogue.vtm.detective.cases: More than I'd like. Missing persons, break-ins at odd hours. You hear things, in this job.
dialogue.vtm.opt.vessel_ask: Ask if they would let you drink from them now and then.
dialogue.vtm.locked.vessel: They do not trust you enough for that yet.
dialogue.vtm.vessel.yes: ...Is that what the dreams are? I'll do it. You are good to me. Just never take more than I can give, %2$s.
dialogue.vtm.vessel.drink: They offer a wrist. It stings, then it is warm, then it is over. They smile faintly and look away.
dialogue.vtm.opt.ghoul_offer: Offer them your own blood in return.
dialogue.vtm.locked.ghoul: They would have to trust you far more.
dialogue.vtm.ghoul.made: They swallow, and the colour comes into them as if it were the first time they had seen light. "Master," they whisper. "Whatever you need."
dialogue.vtm.ghoul.greet: Master. I am here. I will follow, I will fight, I will bleed for you. Ask me anything.
message.vtm.hunters.watching: Someone in %s has been watching you a little too closely.
message.vtm.hunters.hunted: Armed strangers in %s have begun to look for you.
message.vtm.hunters.assault: The hunters of %s are coming for you in force.
message.vtm.hunters.broken: Their inquisitor is dead. The hunters of %s lose heart.
chronicle.vtm.hunters_raid_won: Hunters raided %1$s's haven in %2$s and struck them down.
chronicle.vtm.hunters_raid_lost: %1$s drove off a hunters' raid in %2$s.
dialogue.vtm.hunter.greet.mortal: Evening. I'm %1$s. Not many people walk these streets after dark who don't have to. Be careful out here, %2$s.
dialogue.vtm.hunter.greet.oblivious: Evening. I'm %1$s. Nothing to report. You're out late, %2$s.
dialogue.vtm.hunter.greet.suspicious: %2$s. I've seen you before. Always at the wrong hour, and somehow always near trouble. Mind if I ask what you do?
dialogue.vtm.hunter.opt.explain: Hold their gaze and explain, evenly, that there is nothing to see.
dialogue.vtm.hunter.calmed: ...Yes. Of course. I'm sorry; I'm seeing things. Long nights. Good evening.
dialogue.vtm.hunter.opt.slip: Let the shadows keep you: they forget what they were asking.
dialogue.vtm.hunter.slipped: ...Hm? I was... Where did they go? Funny. I could have sworn.
dialogue.vtm.hunter.exposed: No. No, I know what that is. I know the look. Everyone, here! HERE!
dialogue.vtm.hunter.hunt: Things that are not supposed to be. We don't have a name for them we'd say aloud. We have a list, and it is getting longer.
dialogue.vtm.hunter.opt.watching: Ask who they have been watching.
dialogue.vtm.hunter.watching: I shouldn't. But you look like someone who can be trusted. Two names: they keep odd hours, and they are not ageing as they should.
message.vtm.lodge.standing: The standard of a hunters' lodge. While it flies, every city within reach is more dangerous to be exposed in.
message.vtm.lodge.broken: The standard hangs limp. The lodge is broken, and will not raise its garrison for %s more days.
message.vtm.lodge.master_fell: The master of the lodge is dead. The hunters lose heart.
